waypoints.name: Easy Pass Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount, drive SR-20 east about 45 miles and turn right between mileposts 151 and 152 onto the short spur road signed for Easy Pass, which ends at the trailhead. A Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required to park, and camping on the national park side of the pass needs a backcountry permit.

waypoints.name: Mesahchie Peak
waypoints.directions: Hike the Easy Pass Trail 3.4 miles and about 2,900 ft to Easy Pass, then descend the far side into the Fisher Creek basin at about 5,100 ft. Leave the trail and climb off-trail to a high camp at about 6,700 ft on Mesahchie's south shoulder, then ascend northwest to the Mesahchie-Katsuk saddle and scramble to the summit.
